records.public_claim_text: Over 80% of the State Parties considered that the questionnaire of the Third Cycle allowed to adequately assess the implementation of the Convention at the national level, to evaluate whether the values of World Heritage properties are being maintained over time as well as to record changing circumstances about the state of conservation of the properties.
